item.description:
Hi, there is a loose manhole cover in the zebra crossing in front of the Crawley Estate on Vassall Road. If it is not fixed as soon as possible, someone could fall into the hole and suffer serious injuries. Please arrange for it to be secured urgently to prevent a potentially serious accident. Thank you
